name: qlrisk_price_forward_rate_agreement
title: Price a ForwardRateAgreement
description:
Price one Forward Rate Agreement - OTC forward on interest rate (qlrisk ForwardRateAgreement).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, fixing*, settlement*, fra_rate_pct*, pay_fixed=true, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: day_count.
Example: {"maturity": "18M", "notional": 1000000, "fixing": "1Y", "settlement": "1Y", "fra_rate_pct": 4} gives NPV 1,210.03 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
